quest.title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: Wanderer's Appraisal
quest.description: Your travels with Kichiboushi are reaching their end. You told Ioroi that you would "take Kichiboushi out to eight places to train." So, your last stop will be Stormterror's Lair.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: This city is very big, but... feels grim.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We came here before with a lot of companions, and we fought a battle against Stormterror.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Is Stormterror a large, sharp-tooth, scary dragon with flip-flap wings?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Do you still remember that Anemo Archon statue we saw in Mondstadt?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Anemo Archon Statue...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That big, tall stone statue.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm! Yes! Anemo Archon had big hands!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Stormterror is the archon's good friend! Long ago, the Anemo Archon was from this city, too...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Ooh!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: But if Storm-Storm is so big, how does he get in here?

choices.text: You know, this question feels familiar...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon knows this one! That's because he doesn't walk in...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Ooh, Kichiboushi knows. Storm-Storm can fly. Does not need walking.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A—Argh! How...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm? Paimon, you seem a little unhappiness.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh... We can talk about that later. First off, let's take a photo! Alright, stand still now!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Kichiboushi stand straight!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm... Very nice...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong, Kichiboushi?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: This is a grim city. Very sad, don't know why. Strange.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Next up, let's head into the center of this "city"...

talks.objective: Head for the tower in Stormterror's Lair

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mmmph! The wind... strong...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We can't pass through these storm-walls. We've got to go around!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Easy now, Kichiboushi, just follow us around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're finally here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The view's much better up here. Look over there — that's the spot where we came from!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Paimon likes high spots, mm?

choices.text: You can see everything from these vantage points, and they are good for gliding, too.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Does Storm-Storm sleep here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup — for a really long time, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Even though {NICKNAME} fought Stormterror, he's not a bad dragon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He just experienced something terrible, got hurt, and was tricked by bad people, so he thought that his friend, the Anemo Archon, no longer needed him.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm... Then what happened?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #After that, huh? Do you remember, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I purified his poisoned blood during our battle.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But the platform we were battling on collapsed. At first, it looked like we and the Anemo Archon were going to fall into a deep, dark place...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Eek! That's horrible... What did you do? Did you fly away?

choices.text: Dvalin saved us, and he bore us away.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Dva...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's Stormterror's name.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Stormterror actually had a name of his own, just like Kichiboushi, Paimon, and {NICKNAME} — and his name is Dvalin.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: At first, Dvalin was injured and tricked by some bad people, so he was very angry. That's why he attacked Mondstadt, and because everyone thought he was a bad dragon, they called him "Stormterror."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Later, we beat those bad people and helped the Anemo Archon purify the blood that was tainting him. That was when he realized that the archon hadn't abandoned him.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Ooh! So Storm-Storm became good again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! And that's why Paimon brought you here for training today — it was to tell you the story of Dvalin.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: When you grow older, you will also be misunderstood, get hurt, and experience sad things.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But you mustn't become a bad person. Because "winds change their course"...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And someday, they will blow towards a brighter future...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Was that a bit tough to understand, Kichiboushi?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Understand, but also not really...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: #But Kichiboushi knows that it is something important. Will not forgetting what Paimon and {NICKNAME} say.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe! Then at least our long storytelling session didn't go to waste!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But whatever the case, make sure you don't become too playful or cheeky — that might get you sealed sometime in the future!

choices.text: Looks like this round of your training has drawn to a close.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mmmm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's no need to be so sad! Smile as we go back, or you'll make Ioroi sad, too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright then. Guess we've gotta do our jobs as guides one last time, eh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now then — time to bring Kichiboushi back to Ioroi!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm.

choices.text: Seems like we've completed Ioroi's commission.
Stormterror saved us and bore us away from the battle.
You know what they say about "idiots and smoke..."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's not what this is about! You can see everything from up here, and the air is great, too.

talks.objective: Return to Chinju Forest to visit Ioroi

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back, Ioroi!

dialogues.speaker: Ioroi
dialogues.text: Ooh, you've finally returned! How has Kichiboushi's training gone?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Squelch squelch, kapow!

dialogues.speaker: Ioroi
dialogues.text: Mmhahaha! Good, good!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh brother, we can't understand Kichiboushi anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We even took a lot of photos. Have a look, Ioroi...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You show all the photos you took for Kichiboushi during this time to Ioroi.\nYou also tell him about your adventures.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...And that's how we completed your request to "take Kichiboushi to eight places to train," Ioroi.

dialogues.speaker: Ioroi
dialogues.text: Mm! Good, very good, as might be expected of humans I had mine eye on. If you were also tanuki, you would be great and renowned indeed. Perhaps half as great as I when put together!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (That's not super impressive...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But since we've completed the task, we should probably leave now.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mmmph...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, don't be like that. Come on, Kichiboushi, Paimon's gonna teach you one more thing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When you say goodbye to friends, you should see them off with a smile! That way, you'll be even happier when you meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Ioroi
dialogues.text: ...Mm? Alright. Sure. Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Ioroi
dialogues.text: Kichiboushi says, "Got it, White Fur."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Does this mean...

choices.text: Kichiboushi's lost his ability to speak?

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: It has been some time. The effects of the tanuki meal must have worn off.

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Hmph! If I were free from this stone seal, it would be a thing of ease to have you understand tanuki speech all the time...

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: ...Hmm? Of course, I will pass it on.

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: "Kichiboushi train hard."

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: "Become strong bake-danuki, like Ioroi!"

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Mm? Hahaha! That's quite the boast, you little rascal. Reminds me of myself when I was your age!

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: "Then White Fur and Yellow Fur no eat bake-danuki food, understand Kichiboushi."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll be waiting, Kichiboushi! We'll come train with you next time, too.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Good luck, Kichiboushi.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't get sealed by humans, now.

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Mm!?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm!

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Eh, forget it. I shall not pursue the matter, considering that you did take Kichiboushi out to train.

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Ah, yes. There was once this fellow called Utamarou who painted the tanuki sealed in Chinju Forest and left some drafts behind.

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: You can have it, to look upon whenever you wish to remember the handsome forms of the tanuki race!

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: *sigh* If only you, too, were tanuki...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wouldn't we have been turned into stone already, then?

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Mmph, true. Well then, off you go now. I have a little magic to teach Kichiboushi.

choices.text: We've lost the ability to understand Kichiboushi's speech?
